The main takeaway from our work is that
3D pose inference from RGB images can be achieved in a single-shot manner, without the need for multi-shot or iterative refinement.
a single-shot approach is sufficient for 3D body pose estimation in general settings, and that a single-shot method outperforms a multi-stage approach.
